decisions.subject: Zone use lists defer to the building-type list; secondary-suite-subject units bind to the suite class (G3), as its own M-75 round before night D
decisions.recommendation: The 5 zone use lists 10.x.20.10(1)#whole ('Dwelling Unit in a permitted residential building type in Clause 10.x.20.40') are keyed PROCEDURAL / informational: they defer to the zone's building-type list and never PERMIT a type on their own. The secondary-suite-subject units (e.g. 150.10.20.1(1)(B)) bind to the suite class (house_with_secondary_suite, the M-182 form), not the host type. The set is the 17 units flagged g3_use_list_keying. Implemented as its own M-75 keying round, pre-registered under M-321 (CoA half + Layer 2 expected moves), after G2 and before G5 / night D. Measured on the sample (V8): RD semi 0 / 0 / 100 (no_candidate), RD house unchanged, R house 90.6 / 0 / 9.4. G4 (an absent type reads prohibited) is not ruled; no_candidate stays the honest answer.

decisions.subject: CHAT-172 corrected to the per-family truth: F1 fails closed and is counted; F2/F3 read a refusal phrase in their own grammar inside a condition as an item refusal, uncounted; no code change
decisions.recommendation: Option A: a dated follow-up note to CHAT-172, no code change. F1: a refusal phrase inside a condition makes the notice unknown, counted in notices_unknown. F2/F3: a refusal phrase in the family's own grammar inside a condition is read as an item refusal and is NOT counted; wording outside the family grammar is not read. 0 rows on the closed 70-PDF 2017 corpus, the only documents this extractor reads. Trigger: before this extractor is pointed at any new document, bounding the read at a conditions header (CHAT-172's not-built option) is required first.
